name: axiom-workspace
description: Source workspace for Axiom, a standalone AI-first project-building desktop application.

scripts.test:desktop: node --test desktop/filesystem.test.cjs desktop/project-store.test.cjs desktop/terminal.test.cjs desktop/omniroute.test.cjs desktop/workspace-drift.test.cjs desktop/worker-state.test.cjs desktop/worker-lifecycle.integration.test.cjs desktop/mcp-catalog.test.cjs desktop/mcp-manager.test.cjs desktop/mcp-runtime.test.cjs desktop/runtime-environment.test.cjs desktop/remote-workspace.test.cjs desktop/remote-workspace-runner.test.cjs
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build:webview && npm --prefix desktop start
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build:webview && npm --prefix desktop run dist
scripts.desktop:dist:dir: npm run build:webview && npm --prefix desktop run dist:dir
